regions.full_page: 1. Deo Gratias! This p.M. Marg. Quinn who enrolled her neighbor Mr. Maughan against drink and consequent anger October 26 as also her sister E. Remy of Philadelphia against severe inflamatory rheu- matism, reports "Wonderful improvement in former and letter this A. M. from sister - "Thank God and the Good prayer society I'm feeling fine".
